messages:
linus: heads-up — on the quantized r2 bring-up the numbers are weird. pass@k looks fine but exact-match dropped ~40%. CI metric-sanity flagged a regression. suspecting eval-runner aggregation/windowing + dedupe logic.
priyanka: can you paste a failing sample or logs? my first guess is duplication from beam/streaming being double-counted.
samir: minimal runner config that CI is using: 
```yaml
runner: eval-runner-v2
aggregation_window_ms: 5000
dedupe: false
voting: plurality
canonicalize: none
```
priyanka: ah — aggregation_window_ms is big. that can cause samples from the same request to be bucketed across windows if we get delayed streaming chunks. and dedupe:false would definitely double-count near-duplicates.
linus: here are a couple log lines from the failing job: 
```
INFO 2026-03-10 14:02:11 Runner: starting sample_id=abc123
WARN 2026-03-10 14:02:11 sample 3 seems duplicate of sample 1 (levenshtein 2)
ERROR 2026-03-10 14:02:19 metrics_sanity.assert: expected unique_count >= k (got 2, k=5)
```
priyanka: looks like streaming chunk boundary changes the sample hash. propose: enable dedupe + add canonicalize: normalize_whitespace, lower + strip punctuation before hashing. also set aggregation_window_ms: 0 so we use per-request grouping instead of time windows for pass@k computation.
samir: makes sense. I'll open a PR with the fix, unit tests, and a small smoke test that simulates streamed partials. linking PR: <https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234|#1234> — assigning to @priyanka for review.
eval-bot: test-run #467 failed: metrics_sanity > pass@k_consistency (0.38 vs expected >=0.7) :warning:
deploy-bot: CI status: build 1102 — linux: ✅, macos-latest: ❌ (failing metrics_sanity)
priyanka: ack, will push fix + tests in a bit. adding flaky tag to the CI job for now so we can iterate without blocking release.
linus: thanks. can we also add a lightweight assertion in the harness to catch high duplicate ratios (e.g., dedupe_ratio > 0.1) so this regresses loudly next time?
samir: good idea — I'll add the assertion to smoke and the PR. planning to merge after a green run.
priyanka: local run with canonicalize+dedeupe+per-request grouping: pass@k_consistency 0.72, exact-match recovered to 0.71. pushing patch now.
